commit: 68c4871 (fitted artifacts); see the branch head for the final docs commit

requirements.notes: E2 contributes 2 empirically fitted domains (commercial_intervention_response, software_collaboration_and_adoption); the third (content consumption) is E1's. registry_e2.gate_metrics()['empirical_domains'] lists E2's.
randomized_commercial_response_fitted: implemented (Criteo Uplift v2.1, identification kind randomized_experiment, conditional on features). content_consumption_fitted belongs to E1.

3 held-out reports from E2 alone (validation and test for every candidate; user-level, time-based and repository-level holdouts); the unit tests recompute the test metrics from the data through the registry.
3 baseline comparisons with paired-bootstrap intervals: constant effect, constant rate, proportional rule; each kept model beats its baseline with the interval excluding zero.
Log loss, Brier, ECE (15 equal-mass bins), AUC, AP, reliability tables, Qini/AUUC, Poisson deviance and count calibration by decile in all 3 reports.
3 checkpoints (0.09-0.83 MB, npz without pickle), SHA-256 in the cards, verified on every load; 0 mismatches.
E2 contributes 2 datasets with checksums (1 + 96 files, plus derived-file and extract digests), licenses with text locations and provenance; the third dataset is E1's.
3 extrapolation-limit sections (cards' extrapolation_limits, 8/8/9 items) plus the 'may and may not infer' sections of the guide.
All E2 models are fitted on public empirical data (synthetic: false); synthetic data are used only for the scoring unit test.

4 fidelity rows for the mechanisms E2 grounds (advertising response, its heterogeneity, light-to-deep developer engagement, repository growth) with population, platform, period, held-out result and limits. The register-wide check of important mechanisms is not E2's.

For E2's models metrics_prespecified_before_fit = true (git-verified: plans 06:26:32Z, amendment 07:02:52Z, fits 07:02:59Z and 07:13:48Z) and worse_model_kept = 0. tests/v5/test_gate_SP_5_5.py was not written by E2 (shared with E1); it can call registry_e2.prespecified_before_fit and read selection.worse_model_kept from every card.

limitations: registry_e2.py duplicates the section-5 interface because E1's registry.py did not exist in this worktree; it must be unified.
No simulator module consumes the models yet; the population (B), social (C) and innovation (G) workstreams must wire the cards' simulator_mapping.

Criteo's pooled tests have slightly different treatment ratios (propensity AUC 0.509): the raw difference in means (visit 0.0103) overstates the standardised effect (0.0074-0.0077). This was found in a post-fit diagnostic, which is reported as such.
The kept commercial model wins on log loss but not on uplift ranking (Qini) against the T-logistic.
GH Archive window: four weekdays of 2024; 24 h horizons; observational only.
The commercial card's fit.dirty_paths has its first path truncated by a since-fixed bug in fitmeta_e2.code_state.
integration_notes: Model cards (schema crucible.v5.calibration.model_card/1) live in docs/v5/calibration/models/<name>/model_card.json and name their loader class; any registry can load them generically (see registry_e2.load). E1's registry should scan the same directory so that test_gate_F's registry-driven metrics count E2's three models.
